Revision record
Revision 0.1 | 2026-11-12 | Initial six-sheet opening set.
A1/001–A1/005: editable project records added.
A1/006: verified star-delta wiring retained and assigned sheet number A1/006.
Connectivity baseline: 15 components, 242 wire segments, 26 pin nets.
Q1/F1 overload settings and K1 delay remain unset.
No contactor, timer, motor, overload or protective behavior is simulated.
Next engineering increment: add populated sheets and explicit cross-sheet links.
Design assumptions and limitations
This reference drawing set is incomplete: only A1/001–A1/006 are authored.
A1/006 is a static wiring model with source-backed component identities.
The schematic does not simulate contactor switching or timer sequencing.
Motor behavior, overload trip behavior and breaker interruption are not simulated.
Protection coordination, conductor sizing and installation suitability are not established.
Current and delay settings remain unset; engineers must not infer selected values.
Use only as an educational/reference design pending qualified review.
Not certified; not construction-ready.
